name: Jahangir
contribution: The fourth Mughal emperor of the Mughal Empire, reigning from 1605 until his death in 1627.

checks.lead: Nur ud-din Muhammad Salim (Persian: نورالدین محمد سلیم [ˈnuːrʊˌdɪn/ [mʊ.ɦɑmˈmad̪̚] /sə.liːm]; 31 August 1569 – 28 October 1627), known by his royal name Jahangir (Persian: جهانگیر, Persian pronunciation: [d͡ʒa.hɑːn.ˈɡiːɾ]), was the fourth Mughal emperor of the Mughal Empire, reigning from 1605 until his death in 1627.
